result.detail: Design choices. Properties follow the spec, not RTL internals. They are written as procedural if-guarded immediate assertions so that formal.cover can derive each guard as a cover. No concurrent SVA syntax is used. The only assumption is reset asserted while f_past_valid is 0, which the spec's 'after reset' wording justifies. en, clr and rst_n are otherwise unconstrained, so clear, enable and reset may all occur together. The carry property sits in always @(*) because the spec defines carry combinationally. The engine is smtbmc rather than abc pdr because formal.cover reruns the same engines in cover mode. Known limit: DC-PARAM, the other LIMIT values, is not proved here. A follow-up could change the LIMIT parameter of deep_counter_formal per setup; each would be a separate single-task run. Suggested review check: run the proof on a mutant whose wrap or carry is wrong only at count 99, and confirm the proof fails.
